name: obsidian-claude-connector
description: Connect your Obsidian vault to Claude via Model Context Protocol (MCP). Reads and writes Markdown notes directly from your vault directory.
long_description: Obsidian Claude Connector is a local MCP server that gives Claude access to your Obsidian vault. It exposes five vault tools — list notes, read a note, search notes, create a note, and update a note — letting Claude read and write Markdown files directly from the configured vault directory. No internet connection or Obsidian installation is required at runtime; the server reads files straight from the filesystem.

tools.name: list_notes
tools.description: List notes in the vault, optionally filtered by folder path.

tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read the full Markdown contents of a note by its vault-relative path.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search for notes whose title or content contains a query string.

tools.name: create_note
tools.description: Create a new Markdown note in the vault.

tools.name: update_note
tools.description: Overwrite, append to, or prepend content to an existing note.

vault_path.title: Vault directory
vault_path.description: The root folder of your Obsidian vault. All note paths are resolved relative to this directory.
